verdict.rationale: Asana documents a developer sandbox: a temporary Asana domain with limited users, separate from production workspaces, so API and agent integrations can be tested without touching live data. The Asana-Enable/Asana-Disable headers additionally let developers test upcoming API behavior changes per request without risking their entire app. Missing for 10: details on how to provision the sandbox and how long it lasts, confirmation that MCP/AI Teammate features work in the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
